question: Do the tier-2 measurements ship, with the two contradicting sentences corrected as a follow-up, or does a fourth worker fix them first?

artifacts.summary: Every published number reproduces from its own artifacts: chrF within 0.0005 on all ten scored runs, cer/wer and latency means exactly, XCOMET system scores as the mean of their own per-segment files, all row and segment counts, and the two directions cleanly separated. Two sentences in summary.md and NOTES.md assert what the traces contradict; no acceptance falsifier fires.
